items.title: Nvidia Earnings Give Investors a Barometer for State of AI Trade
items.summary: Wall Street is eagerly anticipating Nvidia Corp.’s earnings on Wednesday afternoon, not so much for what the numbers will say about the chip giant, but for what they mean to artificial intelligence investors and the market itself.

items.title: Salesforce Reports Earnings While Disrupting Itself to Fight AI
items.summary: Salesforce  will report second-quarter earnings on Wednesday afternoon amid the most uncertainty it has faced since its earliest days.  Wall Street analysts are projecting $3.27 in adjusted earnings per share, rising from $2.91 a year ago.  Beginning last year, investors began selling off enterprise software stocks on the idea that much of what they do will be replaced by AI agents that can write software code and execute complex series of tasks from simple conversational commands.

items.title: Salesforce's AI Agent Business Is Growing Over 200%, But Will It Show Up in Its Order Book?
items.summary: The software giant's second-quarter results may show whether AI agents are a growth engine or a pricing problem for SaaS providers.

items.title: ServiceNow Just Ripped 29% in a Month. What Would It Take to Get NOW Stock Up to $150?
items.summary: ServiceNow has surged nearly 30% in a single month and left the broader software sector in the dust, but Wall Street's price targets and a quietly sobering Q3 forecast reveal just how much the stock still needs to prove before bulls can claim victory.
